p: Pets Are Welcome | For your visit to downtown Savannah, our boutique hotel welcomes your most cherished travel companion. To allow your dog to stay in our guest room pet program, please inform the hotel that you’ll have a dog(s) staying with you at least three days in advance of your arrival by calling 912-233-2116. In addition, only dogs weighing 50 pounds and under or two dogs under a combined weight of 75 pounds are permitted. All pet friendly rooms are located on the 2nd floor. For guest tranquility, while exploring the city, treat your pet to a day of bliss at blissfulbuddhapetservices.com. For 30+ nights, the pet fee is at the hotel’s discretion. | *We welcome guests with disabilities traveling with their service animals. Service animals are not pets and are not subject to this Pet Policy. For more information, please contact the hotel. | *Pet Waiver must be signed at check-in. While on property, dogs must be leashed in all common areas. For the comfort of all guests, Food and Beverage outlets are reserved for registered service animals only. Pets cannot be left unattended. | Fees | 1-6 nights (nonrefundable pet fee per stay) | $150 | Stay | + | $300 | 7-30 nights (nonrefundable pet fee per stay)
